question: How many medals did India win in International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2022, which was held in Cairo, Egypt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won 7 medals in the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2022 held in Cairo, Egypt.
 
• India's performance in the shooting World Cup was outstanding, and they finished second in the medals tally, behind China, who won 11 medals.
 
• The International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) is the governing body of the Olympic shooting events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ISSF World Cup is an annual event where shooters from around the world compete in various shooting disciplines.
 
• India has a strong shooting contingent, and they have been performing well in international events in recent years. 
 
• In the ISSF world cup 2022, India won 4 gold medals, 2 silver medals, and 1 bronze medal, showing their dominance in the sport.
 
• India won 15 medals in total—six gold, six silver, and three bronze—to take the lead in the ISSF Junior World Cup 2023 in Suhl, Germany.
